# `AviRtmp`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

State of playing a recorded AVI file out through the live-stream output.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, ReadAviFunc @0x2ee7e0 (64-bit build) |

The AVI-reading worker sends start, then complete when the frame loop ends, or fail with code and error on initialisation problems (state family: code/error only when > 0). Function-state family (F): state is always written; stage only when non-empty; lapse_ms when the timer is started or the state is terminal; code and error at fail even when the stored code is 0 (cancel omits them); route optional. A null or nameless detail sends nothing, and non-working notifications can be suppressed while the function cache still changes, so a receiver cannot rely on seeing every transition. No file name, result or media metadata is added. Recipients: all retained 4700 sockets. No reply-before-event order is established: the RPC reply that starts the worker and the worker's events can arrive in either order. No fixed cadence.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"AviRtmp"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Function producer: idle, working, complete, fail, cancel. Direct (state family) producer: start, complete, fail. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`, `start`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | if non-empty stage string held | - | Only when a non-empty stage string is held. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if function producer: timer started (working) or terminal state | - | Elapsed milliseconds, independent of Timestamp. Working (or any state with a start and no end time, including complete) uses current monotonic minus start; other terminal states use end minus start. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if state is fail | - | Function producer: at fail even if 0. Direct fail (code > 0): 258 open failed, 220 not a video stream or implausible size, 283 output stream initialisation failed; 253 aborted when a stop was already requested. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if state is fail | - | Message for code; present with code. Lookup failure gives fail to operate. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | if optional; absent is a legitimate branch | - | Function-tree ancestry (for example View, Stack) built at send time. May be absent; not an address. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, start - Playback started (READ shape):

```json
{"Event":"AviRtmp","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"start"}
```

Event, open-fail - Open failure (READ code):

```json
{"Event":"AviRtmp","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"fail","code":258,"error":"open file failed"}
```
